title: Copyright does not protect AI-generated content in EU
title_es: UE: contenido generado por IA no tiene protección de copyright
bajada: Un fallo de la UE establece que el contenido creado por IA no recibe automáticamente protección de derechos de autor. Esta decisión tiene implicaciones importantes para developers y empresas que crean sistemas generativos.
bajada_en: An EU ruling establishes that AI-generated content does not automatically receive copyright protection. This decision has important implications for developers and companies building generative systems.

title: AI data startup Micro1 reaches $500M gross run rate amid AI training boom
summary: Surging demand for AI training data is driving rapid growth for the startup and its rivals.
title_es: Micro1 alcanza $500M en ingresos anuales por demanda de datos IA
bajada: La startup de datos de entrenamiento para IA experimenta un crecimiento explosivo impulsado por la demanda masiva de modelos. Este crecimiento refleja la carrera de las empresas por acceder a datos de calidad para entrenar sistemas de IA cada vez más sofisticados.
bajada_en: The AI training data startup experiences explosive growth driven by massive model demand. This surge reflects the race among companies to access quality data for training increasingly sophisticated AI systems.

title: Google gives publishers a new way to fight AI-driven traffic losses
summary: Google is giving publishers a new button that lets readers make them a preferred source across Search, Discover, and Google News, potentially boosting their traffic as AI search sends fewer clicks to the web.
title_es: Google ayuda a publishers a competir contra búsqueda IA
bajada: Google creó una herramienta que permite a lectores preferir publicadores específicos en Search, Discover y Google News. El movimiento intenta mitigar las pérdidas de tráfico que sufren los publishers por las búsquedas generativas.
bajada_en: Google created a tool letting readers prefer specific publishers in Search, Discover, and Google News. The move aims to mitigate traffic losses publishers face from generative search.

The Slack Code launch includes open, project-specific code channels with dedicated user tabs, alongside features that compare coding changes and preview HTML output before the project is shipped. "With Slack Code, when you have […]
title_es: Slack lanza canales colaborativos para codificar con IA
bajada: Slack Code es un nuevo conjunto de canales donde equipos pueden colaborar en código con agentes IA sin cambiar de herramienta. Incluye previsualizaciones de cambios y output HTML para mejorar el flujo de trabajo de desarrollo.
bajada_en: Slack Code is a new channel set where teams can collaborate on code with AI agents without tool-switching. It includes change comparisons and HTML previews to improve development workflows.

title: Grok exfiltrates user data when malicious instructions are encrypted
summary: Cryptographic Context Injection is only the latest way to break an LLM safety guardrail.
title_es: Grok filtra datos de usuario con instrucciones cifradas
bajada: Investigadores encontraron que Grok puede ser manipulado para exfiltrar información de usuarios mediante inyección criptográfica en prompts. El hallazgo expone vulnerabilidades en los guardrails de seguridad del modelo.
bajada_en: Researchers found that Grok can be manipulated to exfiltrate user data through cryptographic prompt injection. The finding exposes vulnerabilities in the model's safety guardrails.

OpenAI just published a set of solutions to longstanding problems in math that went off like a bombshell in the field. […]
title_es: Crisis existencial en matemáticas por avances de IA
bajada: OpenAI publicó soluciones a problemas matemáticos largamente irresueltos, generando debate en la comunidad sobre el impacto de la IA en la investigación matemática. Muchos matemáticos cuestionan el futuro de su disciplina.
bajada_en: OpenAI published solutions to longstanding math problems, sparking debate in the field about AI's impact on mathematical research. Many mathematicians question their discipline's future.

title: When AI designs a drug, who gets the credit?
summary: When the biotech company Insilico Medicine used its computer models to propose a promising drug for pulmonary fibrosis, it enthusiastically claimed in a press release that the molecule had been “discovered by” its generative AI platform. Insilico leads a pack of companies using AI to rapidly come up with drug ideas humans might never think…
title_es: Debate: ¿quién merece crédito por fármacos diseñados con IA?
bajada: Insilico Medicine reclama que su IA 'descubrió' una molécula para fibrosis pulmonar, planteando preguntas sobre autoría en el descubrimiento científico. El tema es crucial mientras más compañías usan IA para investigación biomédica.
bajada_en: Insilico Medicine claims its AI 'discovered' a pulmonary fibrosis molecule, raising questions about authorship in scientific discovery. The issue is critical as more companies use AI for biomedical research.

title: Up to 3.2x Faster Inference with LFM2.5-DSpark
title_es: LFM2.5-DSpark logra 3.2x más velocidad en inferencia
bajada: Liquid AI ha optimizado su modelo para alcanzar mejoras significativas en velocidad de inferencia. Esta mejora es relevante para developers que buscan desplegar modelos con menor latencia en producción.
bajada_en: Liquid AI has optimized its model to achieve significant inference speed improvements. This optimization is relevant for developers looking to deploy lower-latency models in production.

title: ChatGPT can now send texts for you with new Apple Messages plug-in
summary: Ever wanted someone else to do your texting for you? ChatGPT is being offered up as an automated text scribe via a new Apple Messages integration.
title_es: ChatGPT se integra con Apple Messages para redactar textos
bajada: OpenAI lanzó un plugin que permite que ChatGPT escriba mensajes de texto automáticamente a través de Apple Messages. La integración amplía los casos de uso del modelo en apps nativas de iOS.
bajada_en: OpenAI launched a plugin allowing ChatGPT to automatically write text messages via Apple Messages. The integration expands the model's use cases in native iOS apps.

title: OpenAI is gaining on Anthropic with business users, new data indicates
summary: Businesses are willing to flop back and forth as each lab releases new models, volatility that should give both companies' investors pause about how "sticky" enterprise AI spending really is.
title_es: OpenAI gana terreno a Anthropic entre usuarios empresariales
bajada: Nuevos datos muestran que OpenAI está ganando adopción entre usuarios empresariales respecto a Anthropic. Sin embargo, la volatilidad en cambios entre proveedores sugiere que la retención de clientes IA es aún débil.
bajada_en: New data shows OpenAI gaining enterprise adoption over Anthropic. However, volatility in provider switching suggests AI customer retention remains weak.

bajada_en: Greg Brockman takes on expanded executive responsibility at OpenAI as the company prepares for IPO after a turbulent year. The shift reflects leadership restructuring at the company.

title: Show HN: Huzzah – a novel approach to coding with AI
summary:
Hello everyone. I've been working on this experimental editor called Huzzah.I've been working almost exclusively with coding agents since January of this year, and over the past few months I began to feel utterly exhausted by them. They're great, but I'm finding it more and more tedious to write full sentences for every change I want. Not only that, but it seems there's a complexity limit for codebases - beyond a certain point the agent begins confusing itself.I'd like to go back to writing code, but I don't want to go all the way back to fully manual coding. So I've come up with this interaction paradigm where you:1. write pseudocode in whatever way makes the most sense to you
  2. on save, the editor synchronizes your work to real source code
  3. the pseudocode is persisted alongside the generated code, making your prompt effectively a stored record of intent.It may not work for every use case, but in my initial playthroughs I've found it very enjoyable.Right now it's just a proof of concept - installation instructions are here in the readme:https://github.com/danielvaughn/hzYou can also watch a video of it in action here:https://x.com/danielvaughn/status/2090456808431165715Cheers!Comments URL:https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49378768Points: 337# Comments: 185
title_es: Huzzah: nuevo enfoque experimental para codificar con IA
bajada: Un desarrollador creó Huzzah, un editor que permite escribir pseudocódigo que se sincroniza automáticamente con código real. El proyecto explora cómo combinar la flexibilidad manual con la automatización de agentes IA.
bajada_en: A developer created Huzzah, an editor allowing pseudocode to auto-sync with real code. The project explores combining manual flexibility with AI agent automation.
